title: Unforgettably Smoky Malaysian White Cabbage Stir Fry
description: This dish features tender white cabbage, smoky flavors, and a blend of Malaysian spices, all prepared in a vegan-friendly manner using a bain-marie to achieve the perfect texture.
instructions: Prepare the bain-marie by filling a large pot with water to a depth of about 2 inches and bringing it to a simmer over low heat.
In a large heatproof bowl, combine the shredded cabbage, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and place the bowl over the simmering water, covering it with a lid or plastic wrap.
Steam the cabbage mixture for 10 minutes, or until it reaches the desired level of tenderness.
While the cabbage is steaming, heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until it is lightly browned and caramelized.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Stir in the Malaysian curry powder and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
Remove the cabbage from the bain-marie and add it to the skillet, stirring to combine with the onion and spice mixture.
Add the water to the skillet and stir to combine, then cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the cabbage is coated in the spice mixture.
Remove the skillet from the heat and serve the stir-fry hot.
